query: Which quasi-experimental designs (staggered mandates, subsidy introductions, recognition agreements, regulator staffing shocks) best identify macro and firm-level impacts of halal certification?

response.query: Which quasi-experimental designs (staggered mandates, subsidy introductions, recognition agreements, regulator staffing shocks) best identify macro and firm-level impacts of halal certification?
response.answer: Staggered mandates and subsidy introductions are effective quasi-experimental designs for identifying macro and firm-level impacts of halal certification. These methods allow for controlled comparisons over time and across different groups.
